Fees and charges

A standard application costs £42. Applications made in person at a counter cost an additional £12 handling charge.

Replacement documents cost £26. There is no charge if the original was lost in the post while in our care.

These fees apply only to applications made on or after 1 April. Anything submitted before that date is charged at the previous year's rates.

Rights and responsibilities

Your rights: you may ask for a decision to be reviewed at any point within six weeks of receiving it.Your responsibilities: you must tell us within one month if your circumstances change.
A review is free and is carried out by someone who was not involved in the original decision.You must keep records of any payments you receive for at least two years after the claim ends.
If you disagree with the review you can appeal to an independent tribunal.Failing to report a change may mean you have to repay money you were not entitled to.

Applying from abroad

If you live outside the UK you must apply online and post your supporting documents to the overseas processing centre.

Applications from abroad take up to twelve weeks, and you cannot use the fast track service.

This does not apply to Ireland, where the common travel area rules are different.

About the service

The service lets you apply for, renew and track a licence without having to visit an office in person.

You will need proof of identity and a payment card. Most applications are decided within ten working days.

If you have applied before, signing in will pre-fill most of the form using the details we already hold.

Support is available by phone and email if you would rather not apply online, or if you need help part way through.
